task: Why are complaints up this week?
answer:

* The complaints went through Hub W2 and Courier Y.
* "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" assumed Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2; this week it is 77%.
* "End the west backup courier contract" assumed Hub W2 alone can carry west volume; this week the load is 157% of capacity.
* "Run the Festive Flash Sale (40% off kitchen) in the west" assumed hubs can handle the sale volume within daily capacity; this week the load is 157% of capacity.
